nodes.name: Enrich Trigger
nodes.notes: The Supersoniq lane of Enrich Contacts (2026-09-09). Called once per launch with the whole company list; walks it in chunks of 500, asks Supersoniq per chunk at its documented pace, hands each chunk to Enrich Contacts Writer (awaited), then writes its own Hub row "<parent execution>-supersoniq" and answers counters.

nodes.name: Chunk Loop
nodes.notes: One chunk at a time. Loop output: ask the vendor, write, tick. Done output: the lane row and the answer.

nodes.name: SQ Enrich
nodes.notes: Supersoniq companies/enrich, up to 1,000 domains a call, per_company_limit 10, seniors only, tier full so the email rides. One credit per delivered contact.

nodes.name: Call Writer
nodes.notes: Awaited. The writer merges this chunk into People and answers counters; a crash comes back as an error item and is counted, the lane moves to the next chunk.

nodes.name: Log Lane
nodes.notes: The lane's own Hub row, upsert on Execution ID "<parent execution>-supersoniq", Automation "Enrich Contacts Supersoniq", Client attached. A failed write is not fatal: the counters still go back to the Rootflow.
